_about: Massey Ferguson tractors sold in South Africa (JBJ Machinery is an MF dealer). Values come from the official MF South Africa / Africa brochures listed in each entry. Keys ending in _note explain how a value was read. Anything marked ESTIMATE is not published by MF and must be measured on JBJ's tractor.
row_crop_track_note: Setting, not a spec: 2 x 0.75 m maize rows so the tyres run between rows. Within each tractor's published min/max width.

mf_5710.name: MF 5710
mf_5710.transmission: 12x12 synchronised mechanical; power shuttle (Power Control lever + Comfort Control) optional
mf_5710.overall_length_note: front weight frame to rear linkage arms
mf_5710.linkage: Electronic Linkage Control (ELC), Cat 2 fixed ball ends
mf_5710.mass_note: ESTIMATE: not in the SA brochure. Between the MF 4700 Global and the MF 6713 (4230 kg cab). Measure on JBJ's tractor
mf_5710.autonomy_readiness: Mechanical shuttle needs a clutch/shuttle actuator; the power-shuttle option can be driven electrically. ELC hitch is electronic

mf_6713.name: MF 6713
mf_6713.transmission: 12x12 synchronised mechanical shuttle; power shuttle optional
mf_6713.overall_length_note: front weight frame to rear linkage arms
mf_6713.turning_circle_note: brochure lists 'Turning circle* 4500 mm'; geometry shows this is the outer radius, not a diameter
mf_6713.autonomy_readiness: Same as MF 5710: power-shuttle option recommended for autonomy

mf_5m_145.name: MF 5M.145 Dyna-4
mf_5m_145.source: MF Africa brochure MF_5M-Africa-web.pdf (AGCO South Africa 2024) + masseyferguson.com/en_za MF 5M page
mf_5m_145.transmission: Dyna-4 16x16 semi-powershift with Power Control lever (clutch-free, electro-hydraulic shuttle); cab only
mf_5m_145.wheelbase_note: brochure: 2500-2630 mm for 5M.125-145; upper value used
mf_5m_145.overall_length_note: brochure range 4162-4686 mm; lower value (no front weights) used
mf_5m_145.height_roof_note: brochure range 2780-3175 mm (tyre dependent); lower value used
mf_5m_145.turning_circle_note: brochure: 'external diameter less brakes 5,010 mm'; the MF 5M web page gives 4.65 m as a turning radius for the short wheelbase, so this is treated as the outer radius
mf_5m_145.linkage: Electronic Linkage Control (ELC) with draft sensing, Cat 2/3
mf_5m_145.mass_note: brochure shipping mass 4000-5000 kg (long wheelbase); lower value used
mf_5m_145.factory_options: MF Guide (Trimble AutoGuide SM), ISOBUS Lite, Fieldstar 5, AGCommand telemetry on Deluxe/Dyna-4 packages
mf_5m_145.autonomy_readiness: Best candidate: clutch-free electro-hydraulic shuttle + ELC hitch + factory guidance/ISOBUS options, so speed, direction and hitch can be driven by wiring instead of mechanical actuators
